tw.title: 测试超过 10 分钟的 716 次里，67% 是在排队
lines: 为什么排队：测试位一度从 8 减到 4（8 份同时跑内存不够，把正在用的服务挤卡），某晚还临时减到 1；
二十来路会话同时要测试，于是排长队。真跑慢的主要是合并、验收时跑整套（中位约 19 分钟，最长 74 分钟）。
fixes: ① 会话和测试共用一个总池（20 位）  ② 整套只准合并 / 验收跑、最多 2 份，开发只跑点到的测试
③ 单次满 15 分钟熔断  ④ 空闲内存不够不放新测试。11/19 复量效果后补进数据报告。
tw.foot: 来源：测试排队器的运行记录（runs.jsonl）。

tw.title: 67% of the 716 tests that took >10 min were waiting
tw.sub: 4,212 test runs between Nov 11 and Nov 16.
lines: Why the queue: test slots were cut from 8 to 4 (8 at once ran out of memory and froze a live service),
once to 1, with ~20 sessions wanting tests. Slow runs: mostly full suites at merge/review (median ~19 min).
fixes: 1) one shared pool for sessions + tests (20)  2) full suites only for merge/review, max 2; dev runs targeted tests
3) 15-minute circuit breaker  4) no new tests when free memory is low. To be re-measured Nov 19.
tw.foot: Source: the test queue run log (runs.jsonl).

sv.title: One subagent run vs one fresh session (Nov 11 night–Nov 16)
lines: Per run, a subagent is cheaper. We overspent because we spawned too many (916 in ~4 days, $4,722).
To save: spawn fewer; do small lookups yourself by line range. Each row has its own scale.
